data: A floating grid with formulas, clipboard capture and notes.

Scratch opens over the app you’re in with ⌥ Space. Type in the grid, complete a formula with Tab and use the command palette to find actions.

Capture clipboard amounts and screenshots in a new sheet. Keep notes beside the numbers and insert live values, tables or a bar chart. Send the table and notes to an Obsidian daily note or save a dated sheet note.

A/B scenarios were removed in a later update. Read the removal note.

The app is available as a local build from an existing source checkout. The getting started guide walks through the first calculation.
